I will do this plot the way I know and can manage with my money. For beans, I do not like buying chemical fertilizer unless I have really seen it help on a plot like mine, and this season I will keep my cash for the house and use the manure I can get near home. I will plant my usual seed, not improved seed, and because this plot is intercropped and rain-fed, I will work it mostly with family hands and not pay laborers.
